mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we are looking at 55 degrees with light drizzle at Fireman's Park under a waxing crescent moon.

The City of Verona has updated its polling information for upcoming elections. With four locations now available, including the library and city hall, please verify your assigned ward and polling place at the My Vote Wisconsin website before election day.

We have a full schedule of activities starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by evening fun including ART House 360 and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. Tomorrow, you can look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding the weekly report, on October 5th, officers were dispatched to USH 18/151 following a single-vehicle motorcycle crash where a 19-year-old man was transported to a local hospital.
Today's flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
